title: GOG Galaxy, playtime tracking, launch popup

cards.title: GOG Galaxy catalog
cards.body:
Browse the games you own but have not installed, and install them from here. There is a *Promos* tab too, for discounts and giveaways.

It needs the GOG Galaxy app on the device.

cards.title: Playtime tracking
cards.body: Every game is tracked automatically, except for anything tagged *tools*. You can switch tracking off per game from the game menu.

cards.title: A launch popup that tells you something
cards.body:
Confirming a launch now shows the game's playtime, its tags and the plugins enabled for it.

Turn the popup on or off in *Settings > General > App*.

cards.title: Rename from the game menu
cards.body: Custom apps and games can be renamed in place, without leaving the grid.

cards.title: Settings, reorganised
cards.body:
*Settings > Account* is one list now, with a sub-page per store. The store section of the game menu covers Battle.net and GOG as well.

Confirmations that offer several choices are a list of rows instead of buttons side by side.

cards.title: And the fixes
cards.body: Faster loading for the Steam catalog, the Xbox Game Pass *Coming* date now comes from the right place, and a pile of flicker, focus and animation bugs went with it.
